# Marianne Streiff-Feller

Marianne Streiff-Feller (born 1957) is a Swiss politician who has been a prominent figure in the **Evangelical People's Party of Switzerland (EVP/PEV)**.

## Political Career

- She served as a member of the **Swiss National Council** (the lower house of the Swiss Federal Assembly), representing the canton of Bern.
- She became **president of the EVP** (Evangelische Volkspartei), taking on the leadership of the party. She held this role for several years, becoming one of the most recognizable faces of the party.
- Before her national-level career, she was active in cantonal politics in Bern.

## Political Positions

The EVP occupies a centrist position in Swiss politics, combining socially conservative values rooted in Protestant Christian ethics with progressive stances on environmental and social justice issues. Streiff-Feller represented this tradition, advocating for:

- Family-oriented policies
- Environmental protection
- Social welfare
- Ethical governance

## Background

She is from the canton of Bern and has been associated with the town of **Thun** or the surrounding area.
